box.highlights: East Islip 22, Bellport 10: Jake Simmons ran for 225 yards and 2 TDs to lead host East Islip in Suffolk II. Evan Gordon had three tackles for loss and Andrew Arena caught a touchdown. PJ Gannon ended Bellport's last drive with an interception.

Bellport 47, Commack 7: Braydon Cipp completed 6 of 10 passes for 91 yards and two touchdowns and rushed for 58 yards and a touchdown on four carries to lead host Bellport (2-1) in Suffolk II. Cameron Casher rushed for 78 yards on nine carries, Kingston John rushed for 65 yards and a touchdown on nine carries and Luciano Cunha rushed for 42 yards and a touchdown on five carries. Jahiem Talford had five tackles, including one for a loss, and John had an interception. Commack is 1-2.

Bellport 40, North Babylon 7: Kingston John rushed for 118 yards on five carries and 2 TDs to lead visiting Bellport (3-1) in Suffolk II. Luciano Cunha, Braydon Cipp and Matt Chojnacki each added a rushing TD. Dominic Prestano caught a 16-yard TD pass for North Babylon (2-2).

Half Hollow Hills East 23, Bellport 13: Daniel White rushed for 103 yards and two touchdowns to lead Half Hollow Hills East (3-2) in Suffolk II. Jayden Bryan ran for 152 yards and another touchdown. On defense, Gianpierro Nicolia made 12 tackles, forced a fumble and recovered a fumble. Jake Pagliaro contributed eight tackles in the win. Noah Reinstein made a 25-yard field goal and both of his extra points. For Bellport (3-2), Braydon Cipp and Aiden Kerr each rushed for a touchdown.

Bellport 38, Copiague 7: Braydon Cipp completed 5 of 6 passing attempts for 175 passing yards and three TDs, including TD passes of 74 and 67 yards to Cameron Casher and Elie Malcolm, respectively, to lead Bellport (4-2) to a Suffolk II road win. Casher also had three carries for 55 yards and a touchdown. Kingston John ran eight times for 44 yards and a score. Jerome Willet took his only carry to the house for a 64-yard TD. Horace Smith had two catches for 10 yards and a touchdown. Jayden Herrera ran 18 times for 112 yards and a TD for Copiague (2-4).

Huntington 42, Bellport 21: Jack Kamenstein had eight catches for 122 yards and two touchdowns to lead Huntington (5-2) in Suffolk II. Jacob Guzik completed 13 of 15 passes for 205 yards and three touchdowns. Yasir Jones had 20 carries for 126 yards and two touchdowns. Kamenstein had touchdown receptions of 23 and 19 yards in the second half. Ethan Lawless had eight tackles, two sacks and a tackle for loss. Braydon Cipp passed for 136 yards and two touchdowns and ran for 116 yards and a touchdown. Elie Malcom caught seven passes for 105 yards and two touchdowns for Bellport (4-3).

Bellport 20, Smithtown East 14: Braydon Cipp rushed for 171 yards and two touchdowns on 20 carries and completed 10 of his 16 passes for 108 yards to lead Bellport (5-3) in Suffolk II. Kingston John rushed for 58 yards and a TD on 13 carries. Elie Malcom caught four passes for 50 yards. Orion Beadle and Nazir Turner both had two sacks. Antonio Marrone threw two TD passes for Smithtown East (5-3).

Northport 28, Bellport 21: Greyson Cabrera had 3 TDs and an interception to lead host Northport (8-1) in Suffolk II. Simon Blissett completed 13 of 20 passes for 253 yards and Tommy Zarcone and Tristen Magro each had 8 tackles. Shawn Aliperti added 7 tackles and a sack. Cameron Casher had 2 TD runs for Bellport (5-4), including a 60-yard run.
